claims.claim_text: The Republican Party credits President Bush with strengthened cooperation with Europe through NATO, the European Union and individual nations in combating terrorism and weapons-of-mass-destruction proliferation.
The Republican Party credits President Bush's cooperation with Europe with helping build peace and democracy in Afghanistan and Iraq.
The Republican Party credits President Bush's cooperation with Europe with advancing freedom, democracy and opportunity across the broader Middle East and North Africa.
The Republican Party favorably assesses the special relationship and partnership between the United States and the United Kingdom.
The Republican Party favorably assesses joint American-European responses to major challenges and opportunities under strong U.S. leadership.
